description: The pie chart presents the distribution of emotion categories in the context of the paper “Evaluation of Speaker Anonymization on Emotional Speech,” showing 6 slices in total. The slices are labeled with percentages inside each segment: “Neutral” in dark blue at approximately 23.1%, “Happiness” in light blue at approximately 25.1%, a small purple slice at approximately 8.1% (label not fully visible in the image), “Excitement” in red at approximately 14.1%, an orange slice at approximately 14.7% (label not fully visible), and “Anger” in yellow at approximately 14.9%. The chart uses direct percentage labels within the slices and does not show a separate legend; no slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized, and the segments appear arranged around the circle without an explicitly indicated ordering scheme.
